verdict.rationale: LM Studio documents a REST API for driving local models from your own apps and scripts, plus OpenAI-like endpoints served locally or on the network. Headless llmster/Local LLM Service mode covers completions, chat, embeddings and structured outputs, and models load on demand when a request arrives. Community users independently confirm the OpenAI-compatible server and headless flow work with real tools. Missing for 10: an in-depth API reference in the evidence (endpoint list, auth details), and explicit documentation of managing models via the API rather than the CLI.
